summary: 13 film announcements, 15 TV announcements across 5 trades.

film.title: Miami Vice '85
film.talent: Michael B. Jordan, Austin Butler, Alden Ehrenreich
film.announcement: Alden Ehrenreich joins the cast of Universal's latest take on the classic series, alongside Michael B. Jordan and Austin Butler.

film.title: The Dallergut Dream Department Store
film.announcement: Disney Live Action taps Patrick Ness to adapt Miye Lee's fantasy novel for a feature film.

film.title: Charlie vs. the Chocolate Factory
film.talent: Nicola Coughlan, Charithra Chandran, Kate Winslet
film.announcement: Netflix sets release date and 47-day theatrical window for the film, with Nicola Coughlan, Charithra Chandran, and Kate Winslet joining the cast.

film.title: Boys for Life
film.announcement: Paramount's primal comedy casts Alex Wolff, Will Angus, and more Almost Friday stars to lead the film.

film.title: Animals
film.announcement: Trailer released for the Netflix film featuring Ben Affleck and Kerry Washington as distraught parents trying to save their kidnapped son.

film.title: Pinky & the Brain Movie
film.talent: Late writer's son directing with puppets
film.announcement: A late Pinky & The Brain writer's movie script is now being made by his son and will feature puppets.

film.title: Barbie 2
film.announcement: Sequel could be shelved amid pay battle and crumbling deal talks between the studio and key talent.

film.title: Getting to That Age
film.talent: Romy Reiner, Sharon Lawrence, Matt Walsh
film.announcement: First look released for short film featuring Romy Reiner opposite Sharon Lawrence and Matt Walsh.

film.title: Social Reckoning
film.announcement: Jeremy Strong cast as Mark Zuckerberg in Social Reckoning film; actor messaged Zuckerberg after casting about taking responsibility seriously.

film.title: Nimrod's Green Day Movie
film.announcement: Green Day's Billie Joe Armstrong asked the filmmaker to make a movie about the band's album Nimrod, and the filmmaker accepted the project.

film.title: Memoirs of Amorous Gentlemen
film.announcement: Sophia Anne Caruso cast to star in Duncan Sheik's stage musical adaptation of the novel.

film.title: It Ends
film.announcement: Neon sets 36-hour screening event at NYC's Metro Private Cinema with payouts for attendees who stick around.

tv.title: Strike Force
tv.talent: Jesse Lee Soffer (star), Matt Olmstead (writer/producer), Jerry Bruckheimer (producer)
tv.announcement: CBS drama from Matt Olmstead receives development room order with Jesse Lee Soffer set to star.

tv.title: The Lincoln Lawyer Spinoff
tv.announcement: Netflix fast-tracks development of The Lincoln Lawyer spinoff series starring Cobie Smulders as Emi.

tv.title: The Trial of Louise Woodward
tv.announcement: HBO's true-crime limited series adds Sagar Radia to cast alongside Meghann Fahy.

tv.title: The Lowdown
tv.talent: Ethan Hawke, Tommy Lee Jones, Betty Gilpin
tv.announcement: FX sets season 2 release date and releases first photos featuring Tommy Lee Jones and Betty Gilpin.

tv.title: Small Talk
tv.talent: Keegan Allen, Conor Husting, Rio Mangini, Sophia Del Rio, Austin North
tv.announcement: Keegan Allen, Conor Husting, Rio Mangini, Sophia Del Rio, and Austin North star in '70s L.A. music drama.

tv.title: The Best of Us
tv.talent: Neal Huff, Gaby Hoffmann, Sky Yang
tv.announcement: Paramount+ series (formerly titled 9/12) adds Neal Huff, Gaby Hoffmann, and Sky Yang to cast.

tv.title: Thunder Road
tv.announcement: Jake Manley joins AMC's NASCAR drama series.

tv.title: Monster: The Ed Gein Story
tv.announcement: Charlie Hunnam undergoes physical and vocal transformation to play Ed Gein in the limited series.

tv.title: The Paper
tv.announcement: Season 2 trailer released for the Peacock series.

tv.title: Tale of Two Cities
tv.announcement: Kit Harington gets caught in a love triangle in trailer for the series.

tv.title: The Amazing Race
tv.announcement: CBS releases cast photos for season 39.

tv.title: The Traitors: New Blood
tv.announcement: NBC competition releases cast photos for season 1 featuring all-civilian contestants.

tv.title: Amanda Waller Series
tv.announcement: Amanda Waller series is no longer in active development at DC Studios.

tv.title: Paradise Lost
tv.announcement: Wonder Woman prequel series is no longer in active development at DC Studios.

tv.title: Lion
tv.announcement: Jon Favreau directs and discusses his first documentary series about a lion.
